Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. RfMulti is the RF fast-ack-slot layer: the allocator creates and binds the RfFastAckSlot, the move handler indexes the slots per group address and compares RF capabilities (DeviceExtensions.CompareRfRxCapabilities plus the RF segment checks), the validators answer capability/domain/segment questions, and the two flag handlers collect the group addresses of the connectors that have to be re-flagged.
Method.api names: The bodies call the RF-aware APIs directly (RfFastAckSlots, RfDeviceMode, IsReadySlowResender, AckSlotFragmentationPreventer, SetSlowResenderOperation), which fixes the vocabulary of the names.
